appDescription.message: Set video playback speed on the sites you choose. Remembers each site, with presets and keyboard shortcuts.

enableSite.message: Speed up videos on this site

autoStart.message: Start automatically when I open this site

autoStartHint.message: Chrome will ask to allow access to this site only.

unsupported.message: Chrome does not allow extensions on this page. Open a page with a video.

noVideo.message: No video found yet. Start playing one and open this again.

saveFailed.message: Could not save. Close and reopen this window.

permissionDenied.message: Access was not allowed. Speed still applies when you open this window.

cmdToggle.message: Turn speed on or off (current site)
